SELECT d.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM emp_depts ed JOIN departments d ON d.dept_cd = ed.dept_cd JOIN employees e ON e.emp_no = ed.emp_no WHERE d.level = 3 AND d.active = 1 AND ed.is_primary = 1 AND ed.from_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (ed.to_date IS NULL OR ed.to_date >= '2025-12-31') AND e.hire_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= '2025-12-31') AND e.grade_cd <> 'E' GROUP BY d.dept_cd, d.name ORDER BY cnt DESC, d.name;

WITH x AS (SELECT '2025-12-31' AS d), emp AS (SELECT e.emp_no FROM employees e, x WHERE e.grade_cd='G4' AND e.hire_date <= x.d AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= x.d) AND x.d >= date(e.hire_date, '+3 months')), sal AS (SELECT s.emp_no, s.amount_k FROM salaries s JOIN emp USING(emp_no), x WHERE s.effective_from <= x.d AND s.effective_from = (SELECT MAX(s2.effective_from) FROM salaries s2 WHERE s2.emp_no = s.emp_no AND s2.effective_from <= x.d)) SELECT COUNT(*), AVG(amount_k*1000.0), CAST(AVG(amount_k*1000.0) AS INTEGER) FROM sal;
SELECT SUM(days) FROM leave_grants WHERE grant_date = '2024-01-01'
SELECT rating, COUNT(*) FROM evaluations WHERE year = 2023 GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating;

SELECT MAX(s.amount_k) * 1000 FROM employees e JOIN salaries s ON s.emp_no = e.emp_no AND s.effective_from = (SELECT MAX(s2.effective_from) FROM salaries s2 WHERE s2.emp_no = e.emp_no AND s2.effective_from <= e.end_date) WHERE e.status = 'T' AND e.end_date IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE hire_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= '2025-12-31') AND grade_cd <> 'E';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees e LEFT JOIN (SELECT emp_no, SUM(CASE unit_cd WHEN 'D' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'H' THEN 0.5 WHEN 'Q' THEN 0.25 END) AS used FROM leave_usages WHERE use_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY emp_no) u ON u.emp_no = e.emp_no WHERE e.hire_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= '2025-12-31') AND COALESCE(u.used, 0) < 5;

WITH cur AS (SELECT s.emp_no, s.amount_k FROM salaries s WHERE s.effective_from = (SELECT MAX(s2.effective_from) FROM salaries s2 WHERE s2.emp_no = s.emp_no AND s2.effective_from <= '2025-12-31')), tgt AS (SELECT e.emp_no FROM employees e WHERE e.hire_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= '2025-12-31') AND e.grade_cd <> 'E' AND '2025-12-31' >= date(e.hire_date, '+3 months')) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(c.amount_k) AS sum_k, AVG(c.amount_k) AS avg_k, CAST(FLOOR(AVG(c.amount_k) * 1000) AS INTEGER) AS avg_won_floor FROM tgt t JOIN cur c ON c.emp_no = t.emp_no;

SELECT SUM(x.bonus), COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT (SELECT s.amount_k FROM salaries s WHERE s.emp_no=e.emp_no AND s.effective_from<='2024-12-31' ORDER BY s.effective_from DESC LIMIT 1)*1000 * CASE ev.rating WHEN 'S' THEN 20 WHEN 'A' THEN 10 WHEN 'B' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END / 100 AS bonus FROM evaluations ev JOIN employees e ON e.emp_no=ev.emp_no WHERE ev.year=2024 AND e.grade_cd<>'E' AND e.hire_date<='2025-03-31' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date>='2025-03-31')) x

WITH wd AS (SELECT date FROM workdays WHERE is_workday=1 AND date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'), tot AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM wd), emp AS (SELECT emp_no FROM employees WHERE hire_date < '2024-01-01' AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= '2024-12-31')), ab AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.emp_no, wd.date FROM absences a JOIN wd ON wd.date BETWEEN a.from_date AND a.to_date WHERE CAST(a.reason_cd AS INTEGER) IN (10,20) AND a.emp_no IN (SELECT emp_no FROM emp)), cnt AS (SELECT emp.emp_no, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ab WHERE ab.emp_no=emp.emp_no) AS c FROM emp) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cnt, tot WHERE (tot.n - cnt.c) * 1.0 / tot.n < 0.8;

WITH base AS (SELECT e.emp_no, (SELECT amount_k FROM salaries s WHERE s.emp_no=e.emp_no AND s.effective_from<='2025-12-31' ORDER BY s.effective_from DESC LIMIT 1) AS sal_k, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(days),0) FROM leave_grants g WHERE g.emp_no=e.emp_no AND g.grant_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31') AS granted, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE u.unit_cd WHEN 'D' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'H' THEN 0.5 WHEN 'Q' THEN 0.25 END),0) FROM leave_usages u WHERE u.emp_no=e.emp_no AND u.use_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31') AS used FROM employees e WHERE e.hire_date<='2025-12-31' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date>='2025-12-31')), calc AS (SELECT emp_no, sal_k, granted, used, granted-used AS rem, CAST(floor(floor(sal_k*1000*8/(12.0*209))) AS INTEGER) AS daily, floor((granted-used)*2)/2.0 AS days FROM base) SELECT SUM(CAST(daily*days AS INTEGER)) AS total FROM calc;

WITH RECURSIVE sub(dept_cd) AS (SELECT 'D08' UNION ALL SELECT d.dept_cd FROM departments d JOIN sub ON d.parent_cd = sub.dept_cd) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_no) FROM employees e JOIN emp_depts ed ON ed.emp_no = e.emp_no AND ed.is_primary = 1 AND ed.from_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (ed.to_date IS NULL OR ed.to_date >= '2025-12-31') AND ed.dept_cd IN (SELECT dept_cd FROM sub) WHERE e.hire_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= '2025-12-31') AND e.grade_cd <> 'E';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE hire_date <= '2025-06-30' AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= '2025-06-30') AND '2025-06-30' < date(hire_date, '+3 months') AND grade_cd <> 'E'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_no) FROM employees e JOIN emp_depts ed ON ed.emp_no = e.emp_no AND ed.is_primary = 1 AND ed.from_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (ed.to_date IS NULL OR ed.to_date >= '2025-12-31') WHERE ed.dept_cd IN (WITH RECURSIVE sub(c) AS (SELECT 'D11' UNION ALL SELECT d.dept_cd FROM departments d JOIN sub ON d.parent_cd = sub.c) SELECT c FROM sub) AND e.hire_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= '2025-12-31') AND e.grade_cd <> 'E';
SELECT SUM(CASE unit_cd WHEN 'D' THEN 1 WHEN 'H' THEN 0.5 WHEN 'Q' THEN 0.25 END) AS total_days FROM leave_usages WHERE use_date >= '2024-01-01' AND use_date <= '2024-12-31';

WITH ref AS (SELECT e.emp_no, e.grade_cd, e.hire_date, e.end_date, CASE WHEN e.end_date IS NOT NULL AND e.end_date < '2023-12-31' THEN e.end_date ELSE '2023-12-31' END AS d FROM employees e WHERE e.grade_cd <> 'E' AND e.hire_date <= '2023-12-31' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= '2023-01-01')) SELECT r.emp_no, r.d, s.effective_from, s.amount_k, (s.amount_k * 1000 * 8) / (12 * 209) AS daily_wage FROM ref r JOIN salaries s ON s.emp_no = r.emp_no WHERE s.effective_from = (SELECT MAX(s2.effective_from) FROM salaries s2 WHERE s2.emp_no = r.emp_no AND s2.effective_from <= r.d) ORDER BY daily_wage DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT a.emp_no, w.date FROM absences a JOIN workdays w ON w.date BETWEEN a.from_date AND a.to_date WHERE a.reason_cd = '20' AND w.is_workday = 1 AND w.date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31');

WITH t AS (SELECT emp_no FROM employees WHERE hire_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= '2025-12-31') AND grade_cd <> 'E' AND hire_date <= '2025-09-30') SELECT SUM((SELECT s.amount_k FROM salaries s WHERE s.emp_no = t.emp_no AND s.effective_from <= '2025-12-31' ORDER BY s.effective_from DESC LIMIT 1)) * 1000 AS sum_won FROM t;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_no) FROM emp_depts ed JOIN employees e ON e.emp_no = ed.emp_no WHERE ed.dept_cd IN (SELECT dept_cd FROM departments WHERE dept_cd = 'D06' OR parent_cd = 'D06') AND ed.is_primary = 1 AND ed.from_date <= '2024-06-30' AND (ed.to_date IS NULL OR ed.to_date >= '2024-06-30') AND e.hire_date <= '2024-06-30' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= '2024-06-30') AND e.grade_cd <> 'E'

SELECT d.name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_no) AS n FROM departments d LEFT JOIN emp_depts ed ON ed.dept_cd = d.dept_cd AND ed.is_primary = 1 AND ed.from_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (ed.to_date IS NULL OR ed.to_date >= '2025-12-31') LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.emp_no = ed.emp_no AND e.hire_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= '2025-12-31') AND e.grade_cd <> 'E' WHERE d.level = 3 AND d.active = 1 GROUP BY d.dept_cd, d.name ORDER BY n DESC, d.name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_no) FROM employees e JOIN emp_depts d ON d.emp_no = e.emp_no WHERE d.is_primary = 0 AND d.from_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (d.to_date IS NULL OR d.to_date >= '2025-12-31') AND e.hire_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= '2025-12-31');

WITH cur AS (SELECT s.emp_no, s.amount_k FROM salaries s WHERE s.effective_from = (SELECT MAX(s2.effective_from) FROM salaries s2 WHERE s2.emp_no = s.emp_no AND s2.effective_from <= '2025-12-31')) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(c.amount_k) AS sum_k, (SUM(c.amount_k) * 1000) / COUNT(*) AS avg_won_floor, CAST(SUM(c.amount_k) * 1000 AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS avg_won_exact FROM employees e JOIN cur c ON c.emp_no = e.emp_no WHERE e.grade_cd = 'G4' AND e.hire_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= '2025-12-31') AND e.hire_date <= date('2025-12-31','-3 months');
SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(days) FROM leave_grants WHERE grant_date = '2024-01-01'
SELECT rating, COUNT(*) FROM evaluations WHERE year = 2023 GROUP BY rating ORDER BY CASE rating WHEN 'S' THEN 1 WHEN 'A' THEN 2 WHEN 'B' THEN 3 WHEN 'C' THEN 4 WHEN 'D' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

SELECT e.emp_no, e.status, e.grade_cd, e.end_date, (SELECT s.amount_k FROM salaries s WHERE s.emp_no=e.emp_no AND s.effective_from <= e.end_date ORDER BY s.effective_from DESC LIMIT 1) AS amt_k FROM employees e WHERE e.end_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY amt_k DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE hire_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= '2025-12-31') AND grade_cd <> 'E'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees e LEFT JOIN (SELECT emp_no, SUM(CASE unit_cd WHEN 'D' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'H' THEN 0.5 WHEN 'Q' THEN 0.25 END) AS d FROM leave_usages WHERE use_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY emp_no) u ON u.emp_no = e.emp_no WHERE e.hire_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= '2025-12-31') AND COALESCE(u.d, 0) < 5

WITH base AS (SELECT e.emp_no FROM employees e WHERE e.hire_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= '2025-12-31') AND e.grade_cd <> 'E' AND e.hire_date <= date('2025-12-31','-3 months')), cur AS (SELECT s.emp_no, s.amount_k FROM salaries s WHERE s.effective_from <= '2025-12-31' AND s.effective_from = (SELECT MAX(s2.effective_from) FROM salaries s2 WHERE s2.emp_no = s.emp_no AND s2.effective_from <= '2025-12-31')) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, (SUM(c.amount_k)*1000)/COUNT(*) AS avg_won, SUM(c.amount_k)*1000.0/COUNT(*) AS avg_raw FROM base b JOIN cur c ON c.emp_no = b.emp_no;

WITH emp AS (SELECT emp_no FROM employees WHERE hire_date < '2024-01-01' AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= '2024-12-31') AND grade_cd <> 'E'), wd AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM workdays WHERE is_workday = 1 AND date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'), abs_days AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.emp_no, w.date FROM absences a JOIN workdays w ON w.date BETWEEN a.from_date AND a.to_date AND w.is_workday = 1 WHERE a.reason_cd IN ('10','20') AND w.date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'), rates AS (SELECT e.emp_no, (SELECT n FROM wd) AS total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM abs_days d WHERE d.emp_no = e.emp_no) AS absent FROM emp e) SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_under_80, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emp) AS emp_total, (SELECT n FROM wd) AS workdays_2024 FROM rates WHERE (total - absent) * 1.0 / total < 0.8;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(bonus) AS total FROM (SELECT (s.amount_k*1000) * CASE ev.rating WHEN 'S' THEN 20 WHEN 'A' THEN 10 WHEN 'B' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END / 100 AS bonus FROM evaluations ev JOIN employees e ON e.emp_no=ev.emp_no JOIN salaries s ON s.emp_no=e.emp_no AND s.effective_from = (SELECT MAX(s2.effective_from) FROM salaries s2 WHERE s2.emp_no=e.emp_no AND s2.effective_from <= '2024-12-31') WHERE ev.year=2024 AND e.grade_cd <> 'E' AND e.hire_date <= '2025-03-31' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= '2025-03-31'));

WITH emp AS (SELECT emp_no FROM employees WHERE hire_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= '2025-12-31')), sal AS (SELECT s.emp_no, s.amount_k FROM salaries s WHERE s.effective_from = (SELECT MAX(s2.effective_from) FROM salaries s2 WHERE s2.emp_no = s.emp_no AND s2.effective_from <= '2025-12-31')), g AS (SELECT emp_no, SUM(days) d FROM leave_grants WHERE grant_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY emp_no), u AS (SELECT emp_no, SUM(CASE unit_cd WHEN 'D' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'H' THEN 0.5 WHEN 'Q' THEN 0.25 ELSE 0 END) d FROM leave_usages WHERE use_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY emp_no), r AS (SELECT e.emp_no, s.amount_k, MAX(0, COALESCE(g.d,0) - COALESCE(u.d,0)) AS rem FROM emp e LEFT JOIN sal s ON s.emp_no = e.emp_no LEFT JOIN g ON g.emp_no = e.emp_no LEFT JOIN u ON u.emp_no = e.emp_no), p AS (SELECT emp_no, amount_k, CAST(rem*2 AS INTEGER) AS d2, rem FROM r) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN amount_k IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_salary, SUM(CAST(amount_k*8000/2508 AS INTEGER) * d2 / 2) AS total_won, SUM(d2 > 0) AS payees FROM p;

WITH t AS (SELECT e.hire_date, e.end_date, date(substr(e.hire_date,1,7)||'-01','+3 months') AS m3 FROM employees e) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t WHERE hire_date <= '2025-06-30' AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= '2025-06-30') AND '2025-06-30' < date(m3,'+'||(min(CAST(substr(hire_date,9,2) AS INTEGER), CAST(strftime('%d', date(m3,'+1 month','-1 day')) AS INTEGER))-1)||' days');

WITH RECURSIVE sub(dept_cd) AS (SELECT 'D08' UNION ALL SELECT d.dept_cd FROM departments d JOIN sub s ON d.parent_cd = s.dept_cd) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_no) FROM employees e JOIN emp_depts ed ON ed.emp_no = e.emp_no AND ed.is_primary = 1 AND ed.from_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (ed.to_date IS NULL OR ed.to_date >= '2025-12-31') AND ed.dept_cd IN (SELECT dept_cd FROM sub) WHERE e.hire_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= '2025-12-31') AND e.grade_cd <> 'E';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emp_depts ed JOIN employees e ON e.emp_no = ed.emp_no WHERE ed.dept_cd = 'D11' AND ed.is_primary = 1 AND ed.from_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (ed.to_date IS NULL OR ed.to_date >= '2025-12-31') AND e.hire_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= '2025-12-31') AND e.grade_cd <> 'E'

WITH s AS (SELECT emp_no, effective_from, amount_k, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY emp_no ORDER BY effective_from DESC) rn FROM salaries WHERE effective_from <= '2023-12-31') SELECT e.emp_no, e.name, e.hire_date, e.end_date, e.status, e.grade_cd, s.effective_from, s.amount_k FROM employees e JOIN s ON s.emp_no=e.emp_no AND s.rn=1 WHERE e.hire_date <= '2023-12-31' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= '2023-12-31') AND e.grade_cd <> 'E' ORDER BY s.amount_k DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT unit_cd, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE unit_cd WHEN 'D' THEN 1 WHEN 'H' THEN 0.5 WHEN 'Q' THEN 0.25 END) FROM leave_usages WHERE use_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' GROUP BY unit_cd

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT emp_no||'|'||date) AS emp_day_distinct, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS day_distinct FROM absences a JOIN workdays w ON w.date BETWEEN a.from_date AND a.to_date WHERE a.reason_cd='20' AND w.is_workday=1 AND w.date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_no) FROM emp_depts d JOIN employees e ON e.emp_no = d.emp_no WHERE d.dept_cd = 'D06' AND d.is_primary = 1 AND d.from_date <= '2024-06-30' AND (d.to_date IS NULL OR d.to_date >= '2024-06-30') AND e.hire_date <= '2024-06-30' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= '2024-06-30') AND e.grade_cd <> 'E'

WITH X AS (SELECT '2025-12-31' AS d), tgt AS (SELECT e.emp_no FROM employees e, X WHERE e.hire_date <= X.d AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= X.d) AND e.grade_cd <> 'E' AND X.d >= date(e.hire_date, '+3 months')), cur AS (SELECT s.emp_no, s.amount_k FROM salaries s JOIN X ON s.effective_from <= X.d WHERE s.effective_from = (SELECT MAX(s2.effective_from) FROM salaries s2 WHERE s2.emp_no = s.emp_no AND s2.effective_from <= X.d)) SELECT (SELECT SUM(c.amount_k) FROM cur c JOIN tgt t ON t.emp_no = c.emp_no) * 1000 AS sum_won;
